 Insight Exclusive | Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' Locks November 12 As Global Streaming Premiere on Prime Video 
 Upon its OTT release, 'Jailer 2' will be available to stream in India and across more than 240 countries and territories worldwide in Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam, and Kannada. A poster of 'Jailer 2' Saniya Patel Updated on :  04 Nov 2026, 6:30 pm 
 Copied 
 Quick Read AI generated summary, newsroom reviewed
 Nelson Dilipkumar and Rajinikanth’s blockbuster sequel, Jailer 2, which just over a week ago became the highest-grossing Tamil film of all time, will now premiere exclusively on Prime Video on November 12. 
 Directed by Dilipkumar, Jailer 2  sees the Tamil superstar reprise his iconic role as 'Tiger' Muthuvel Pandian — a quiet and kept-to-himself man, living behind the mask of an ordinary car driver.
 You May Also Like Everything You Need To Know Before Watching Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' Opening up about the overwhelming response to Jailer 2, Rajinikanth in his role and the film's eventual release on the OTT platform, Dilipkumar said, "The response to Jailer was extraordinary, and the love audiences have shown for Muthuvel Pandian has been one of the most rewarding aspects of this journey. With Jailer 2 , we wanted to build on that special connection while taking the story, action, scale, and emotional stakes to an entirely new level."
 "Having Rajinikanth sir reprise his iconic role as Muthuvel Pandian, alongside such a formidable ensemble cast, with Anirudh’s music adding its own distinctive energy, made this chapter particularly exciting for us. Following the film’s spectacular theatrical response, we’re delighted to bring Jailer 2 to Prime Video, where it will join Jailer , taking both chapters of Muthuvel Pandian’s story to audiences in India and across the world,” he added. 
 You May Also Like 'Dharman': Sreeleela Joins Nayanthara, Rajinikanth In Ashwath Marimuthu's Thriller Dilipkumar's actioner also starred a spectacular ensemble cast, including SJ Suryah, Shivarajkumar, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Mithun Chakraborty, Vidya Balan, Ramyakrishnan, Namo Narayana, and Yogi Babu, with special appearances by Mohanlal, Hrithik Roshan and Vijay Sethupathi. 
 Upon releasing on Prime Video, Jailer 2 will be available to stream in India and across more than 240 countries and territories worldwide in Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam, and Kannada.
